description: Extract tables (rows and header-keyed records) from a PDF given by public URL or base64 (max 4 MiB, 30 pages). 'lines' strategy for ruled tables, 'text' for whitespace-aligned ones. Price: 0.04 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/pdf-tables.

header.description: Also return rows as records keyed by the first row.

pages.description: 1-based pages to read. Default: all (up to max_pages).

pdf_base64.description: Alternative to 'url': base64 PDF bytes (max 4 MiB decoded).

strategy.description: 'lines' for ruled tables, 'text' for whitespace-aligned columns.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF (max 4 MiB, 3 redirects, public IPs only).

name: pdf_tables
title: PDF table extraction
